clue.text: Section dispatched to capture GM drug

explanation.surface: A section of crops is sent off for testing, to catch genetically modified material in a drug.
explanation.walkthrough: GM is genetically modified; 'to capture' means the dispatched word goes around both the following pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A segment is one part or portion cut from a whole, the same as a section.

clue.text: Chaplain has forty winks after second drink

clue.text: [Stuff spread about book about language]

explanation.surface: Instructions for filling and spreading, wrapped around a textbook on words.
explanation.walkthrough: The first 'about' reverses the joined pieces; the second is part of the definition. The source prints this clue in square brackets.
explanation.definitionFit: A grammar is a book setting out the rules of a language, so it is a book about language.

clue.text: Order girl into treatment for psychiatric problems

explanation.definitionFit: An edict is an official decree issued by an authority, which is an order.

clue.text: Time one sergeant major admitted "mistake is organised violence and intimidation"

clue.text: Englishman taken the wrong way in skirt

clue.text: Bravest prince most fortunate

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for prince

clue.text: Revenue protecting Ministry of Defence in trouble

clue.text: Wet earth home to famous plant

explanation.definitionFit: Mustard is a plant of the cabbage family grown for its seeds and leaves.

clue.text: Priest interrupts unusual hymn to mythological deity

clue.text: Colour of mega tan damage?

clue.text: Taking five bearings, animal leads to crop

clue.text: Warning sign of endless damage to irresponsible drinker
